SPIRITS-TEST_CARD.title: Card
SPIRITS-STRIKE_SPIRITS.title: Strike
SPIRITS-DEFEND_SPIRITS.title: Defend
SPIRITS-SPLATTER.title: Splatter
SPIRITS-SPLATTER.description:
Apply {Debuff:diff()} [gold]Bind[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Dissolve[/gold] {Dissolve:diff()}: Apply {Debuff2:diff()} additional [gold]Bind[/gold].
SPIRITS-LOOSE_THREADS.title: Loose Threads
SPIRITS-FORMING.title: Forming
SPIRITS-NEEDLEWORK.title: Needlework
SPIRITS-WIRECASTING.title: Wirecasting
SPIRITS-IMPACT_PREP.title: Impact Prep
SPIRITS-IMPACT_PREP.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] next turn.
[gold]Dissolve[/gold] {Dissolve:diff()}: Gain {Block2:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] next turn.
SPIRITS-ETCHING.title: Etching
SPIRITS-ROTATION.title: Rotation
SPIRITS-TEARAWAY.title: Tearaway
SPIRITS-TEARAWAY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dissolve[/gold] {Dissolve:diff()}: Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SPIRITS-MASS_EXPULSION.title: Mass Expulsion
SPIRITS-MASS_EXPULSION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage once.
[gold]Dissolve[/gold] {Dissolve:diff()}: Hit twice as many times.
[gold]Dissolve[/gold] {Dissolve:diff()}: Hit twice as many times.{IfUpgraded:show:
[gold]Dissolve[/gold] {Dissolve:diff()}: Hit twice as many times.}
SPIRITS-SPIRIT_BLADE.title: Spirit Blade
SPIRITS-SPIRIT_BLADE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {StaticGain:diff()} [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]. Consume. Retain.
SPIRITS-ACTIVATE_FIRE_REMNANT.title: Activate Fire Remnant
SPIRITS-ACTIVATE_FIRE_REMNANT.descriptio: Gain Flash equal to your Fire Remnant stacks. Retain. Consume.
SPIRITS-RETURN_IT_IN_KIND.title: Return It in Kind
SPIRITS-RETURN_IT_IN_KIND.description: Void. Consume. If the enemy has Strength, apply Weak {WeakAmount:diff()}. If the enemy has Dexterity, apply Vulnerable {VulnAmount:diff()}. If the enemy has Block, deal additional damage equal to {BlockMult:diff()}x its Block value.
SPIRITS-EARTHSHATTER.title: Earthshatter
SPIRITS-THUNDER_CLAP.title: Thunder Clap
SPIRITS-THUNDER_CLAP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Apply Weak {WeakPower:diff()}.
SPIRITS-SEVEN_WOUNDS_FIST.title: Seven-Wounds Fist
SPIRITS-GEOMAGNETIC_GRIP.title: Geomagnetic Grip
SPIRITS-PERFECT_JADE.title: Perfect Jade
SPIRITS-BOULDER_SMASH.title: Boulder Smash
SPIRITS-RESONANT_PULSE.title: Resonant Pulse
SPIRITS-RESONANT_PULSE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the damage dealt. Void.
SPIRITS-PULSE_CARD.title: Pulse
SPIRITS-PULSE_CARD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, then deal additional damage equal to your [gold]Static Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-DISSIMILATE.title: Dissimilate
SPIRITS-DISSIMILATE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. [gold]Flash[/gold] 2. Void.
SPIRITS-SOARING_STRIKE.title: Soaring Strike
SPIRITS-SOARING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. End the current turn. At the start of your next turn, gain 2 Energy.
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_STRIKE.title: Drunken Strike
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_STRIKE.description: Swap your Dexterity and Strength. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
SPIRITS-ROLLING_STRIKE.title: Rolling Strike
SPIRITS-ROLLING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have drawn a card this turn, refund 1 Energy.
SPIRITS-REKINDLE.title: Rekindle
SPIRITS-REKINDLE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a single enemy. Heal HP equal to the damage dealt. [gold]Flash[/gold] 3. Consume.
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ZHAO.title: Return to Zhao
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ZHAO.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a single enemy. If this kills, gain {StoneGain:diff()} [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold]; otherwise gain {BranchBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIRITS-DOUBLE_IMPACT.title: Double Impact
SPIRITS-DOUBLE_IMPACT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a single enemy. Return a random Attack from your discard pile to your hand. [gold]Flash[/gold] 2.
SPIRITS-SHATTERING_STRIKE.title: Shattering Strike
SPIRITS-SHATTERING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Randomly Consume 2 cards from your hand. Void.
SPIRITS-HARDENED_STRIKE.title: Hardened Strike
SPIRITS-SLEIGHT_OF_FIST.title: Sleight of Fist
SPIRITS-SLEIGHT_OF_FIST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. [Double damage in Elite rooms].
SPIRITS-SHADOWLESS_KICK.title: Shadowless Kick
SPIRITS-SHADOWLESS_KICK.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. [Double damage in normal rooms].
SPIRITS-ION_SEVER.title: Ion Sever
SPIRITS-ION_SEVER.description: Deal 7 damage. Gain Static Remnants equal to damage dealt. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-DANCE_OF_SHADOWS.title: Dance of Shadows
SPIRITS-DANCE_OF_SHADOWS.description: Deal 9 damage. Draw 1 card for every 5 Static Remnants. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-ETHEREAL_IMPACT.title: Ethereal Impact
SPIRITS-ETHEREAL_IMPACT.description: Deal 1 damage. Enemy gains 1 Intangible. You gain 1 Intangible. Void. [Cost 2 → 1].
SPIRITS-EARTHBREAKER.title: Earthbreaker
SPIRITS-EARTHBREAKER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Plated Armor {PlatedArmor:diff()}. Vulnerable 1. Draw 1. [Repeat once].
SPIRITS-NONLOCALITY.title: Nonlocality
SPIRITS-NONLOCALITY.description: Remove Etherealized state and all negative statuses. Retain. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-BEDROCK.title: Bedrock
SPIRITS-BEDROCK.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. This turn, [gold]Stone Remnant[/gold] triggers do not consume [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold]. !Consume.
SPIRITS-LAYERED_ROCK.title: Layered Rock
SPIRITS-SOLID_ROCK.title: Solid Rock
SPIRITS-MAGNETIZE.title: Magnetize
SPIRITS-MAGNETIZE.description: Consume all Stone Remnants. For each stack: gain X Plated Armor (X+1), gain 1 Energy.
SPIRITS-PETRIFYING_HEX.title: Petrifying Hex
SPIRITS-PETRIFYING_HEX.description: Apply Weak {Weak:diff()} to ALL enemies. Apply Vulnerable {Vuln:diff()} to ALL enemies. Gain {StoneGain:diff()} [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-EMBER_BREW.title: Ember Brew
SPIRITS-EMBER_BREW.description: Lose 4 HP. Gain Flash 1. Gain 2 Strength.
SPIRITS-SMOKE_CLEARS.title: Smoke Clears
SPIRITS-EMBER_PACT.title: Ember Pact
SPIRITS-EMBER_PACT.description: Consume 1 card from hand. Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}. [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. Consume.
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT_CARD.title: Fire Remnant
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT_CARD.description: Gain {FireGain:diff()} [gold]Fire Remnant[/gold]. If no Activate Fire Remnant in hand, add one.
SPIRITS-IN_AN_INSTANT.title: In an Instant
SPIRITS-IN_AN_INSTANT.description: Innate. Gain Flash 2. Gain 7 Static Remnants.
SPIRITS-GLIDING_SHADOW.title: Gliding Shadow
SPIRITS-ELECTRIC_VORTEX.title: Electric Vortex
SPIRITS-WATER_WEARS_STONE.title: Water Wears Stone
SPIRITS-BULWARK.title: Bulwark
SPIRITS-BULWARK.description: Gain {StaticGain:diff()} [gold]Static Remnants[/gold], then gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your [gold]Static Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE_CARD.title: Real Phase
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE_CARD.description: Gain 3 Static Remnants. Next SR trigger deals double damage. Apply Real Phase 1. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE_CARD.title: Imaginary Phase
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE_CARD.description: Gain 3 Static Remnants. Next SR trigger doesn't consume. Void. Apply Imaginary Phase 1. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-WIND_FILLS_TOWER.title: Wind Fills Tower
SPIRITS-BY_THEIR_STRENGTH.title: By Their Strength
SPIRITS-BY_THEIR_STRENGTH.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Void. If you take damage this turn, add Return It in Kind to hand.
SPIRITS-ROLLING_BOULDER.title: Rolling Boulder
SPIRITS-RECTIFY.title: Rectify
SPIRITS-RECTIFY.description: Void. Discard hand, reshuffle. Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy. Draw 3 cards.
SPIRITS-FLAME_SHIELD.title: Flame Shield
SPIRITS-FLAME_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Whenever attacked, deal {RetaliationDmg:diff()} damage to attacker.
SPIRITS-SUNFIRE_LASH.title: Sunfire Lash
SPIRITS-SUNFIRE_LASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to 3 random enemies. Apply Weak 2.
SPIRITS-SACRIFICIAL_HEART.title: Sacrificial Heart
SPIRITS-SACRIFICIAL_HEART.description: Void. At the start of each turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
SPIRITS-ENERGIZE.title: Energize
SPIRITS-SHADOW_MAKES_THREE.title: Shadow Makes Three
SPIRITS-SPOT_THE_OPENING.title: Spot the Opening
SPIRITS-SPOT_THE_OPENING.description: If an enemy intends to attack, gain {Dex:diff()} Dexterity and [gold]Flash[/gold] 1.
SPIRITS-ASTRAL_STEP.title: Astral Step
SPIRITS-ASTRAL_STEP.description: Void. Add 2 Spirit Blades to hand.
SPIRITS-RESONANCE.title: Resonance
SPIRITS-RESONANCE.description: Void. When you play your next card, draw every card of same rarity from draw and discard piles.
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ORIGIN.title: Return to Origin
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ORIGIN.description: Void. Repeatedly consume Flash 1 / Stone Remnants 2 / Static Remnants 4 until can't. Gain 1 Intangible per full cycle. [Cost 2 → 1].
SPIRITS-POLISH_JADE.title: Polish Jade
SPIRITS-POLISH_JADE.description: Void. Choose 1 of 3 random non-colorless class cards. Put it in your hand at 0 cost. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-AETHER_REMNANT.title: Aether Remnant
SPIRITS-CRAVING.title: Craving
SPIRITS-CRAVING.description: Lose 3 HP. Draw 2 cards. Gain 1 Energy. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-EVER_FIRM.title: Ever Firm
SPIRITS-EVER_FIRM.description: Gain {PlatedArmor:diff()} Plated Armor. Immediately gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your Plated Armor.
SPIRITS-BALL_LIGHTNING.title: Ball Lightning
SPIRITS-BALL_LIGHTNING.description: Deal 3X damage. Draw X cards. Refund 1 Energy per Attack drawn. [X+1 when upgraded].
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_FIST.title: Drunken Fist
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_FIST.description: Lose 1 HP and gain 2 Dex and 2 Str, X times [X+1].
SPIRITS-GRAY_FLY.title: Gray Fly
SPIRITS-THOUSAND_CRAGS.title: Thousand Crags
SPIRITS-THOUSAND_CRAGS.description: At the end of your turn, gain {StoneGain:diff()} [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-STONE_CORE.title: Stone Core
SPIRITS-BOULDER_FORM.title: Boulder Form
SPIRITS-BOULDER_FORM.description: Etherealize. Immune to Vulnerable/Frail/Weak. Consume all Stone Remnants, gain Block=8x, Plated Armor=4x, Strength=2x. Retain.
SPIRITS-CRYSTALLIZATION.title: Crystallization
SPIRITS-CRYSTALLIZATION.description: Innate. Your Plated Armor gains +1 instead of -1 at end of turn.
SPIRITS-EMBER_FORM.title: Ember Form
SPIRITS-EMBER_FORM.description: Etherealize. Each turn start: draw 1 card, gain Flash 1. Flash 1.
SPIRITS-IONIZATION.title: Ionization
SPIRITS-IONIZATION.description: Innate. After Static Remnants trigger, gain 4 Static Remnants.
SPIRITS-STORM_FORM.title: Storm Form
SPIRITS-STORM_FORM.description: Etherealize. Cost cap becomes 1. Cards drawn cost 1. When you play a 0-cost card, draw 1.
SPIRITS-EVER_CHANGING.title: Ever Changing
SPIRITS-EVER_CHANGING.description: Void. At end of turn: consume 4 SR→Flash 2; Flash 2→SR 8; SR 8→Stone 4. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-UNIFIED_FIELD_THEORY.title: Unified Field Theory
SPIRITS-UNIFIED_FIELD_THEORY.description: Innate. Void. At start of turn, randomly gain Flash 1, Stone Remnants 2, or Static Remnants 4.
SPIRITS-VOID_FORM.title: Void Form
SPIRITS-VOID_FORM.description: Etherealize. Cards in hand without Void gain Void; cards with Void lose it.
SPIRITS-ELEMENTAL_SEPARATION.title: Elemental Separation
SPIRITS-ELEMENTAL_SEPARATION.description: Innate. Etherealize. Each turn start, add 4 random elemental cards to hand.
SPIRITS-READ_THE_FOE.title: Read the Foe
SPIRITS-READ_THE_FOE.description: If you took no damage last turn, gain {Energy:diff()} Energy at the start of your turn.
SPIRITS-INTRINSIC_ADVANTAGE.title: Intrinsic Advantage
SPIRITS-ENTANGLEMENT.title: Entanglement
SPIRITS-ENTANGLEMENT.description: Void. Whenever you gain [gold]Flash[/gold], [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold], or [gold]Static Remnants[/gold], also gain {Dex:diff()} temporary Dexterity.
SPIRITS-UNFETTERED.title: Unfettered
SPIRITS-UNFETTERED.description: Innate. You may play Curse and Status cards. They are Consumed.
SPIRITS-DROWN_SORROW.title: Drown Sorrow
SPIRITS-DROWN_SORROW.description: Innate. Whenever you take damage during your turn, if HP < 50%, heal {Heal:diff()}.
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD_POWER.title: Overload
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD_POWER.description: Innate. After using a Skill, gain 1 Overload. Overload cap = Overload stacks.
SPIRITS-VOID_ECHO.title: Void Echo
SPIRITS-VOID_ECHO.description: Void. At start of turn, return 1 random card from consumed pile to hand. [Cost 2 → 1].
